title: Micah’s House of Gods
reflectionText: Micah restored the silver he had taken, and his mother had images made from it. He made an ephod and teraphim; there was no king in Israel. He then consecrated a young Levite to be his priest and said, “Now I know that Yahweh will do good to me.” On what do you rest your confidence that good will come?
editorialNotes: Packet 030 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within Judges 17:1-13, renders verse 6’s opening time phrase as “At that time” in both lanes, and ends with Micah’s words in verse 13.
